title: Authority to enter agreements.
bodyText: The director may enter into or make agreements, arrangements, or declarations to carry out the purposes of this part.
bodyHtml: [§286-247]  Authority to enter agreements.  The director may enter into or make agreements, arrangements, or declarations to carry out the purposes of this part. [L 1989, c 320, pt of §2; am L 1990, c 342, §16]
